It seems the system is not accepting the tool call due to formatting. Possibly need to ensure no newline inside tags. Also ensure that the JSON is valid. Let's craft minimal.

<thought>We need to verify route.</thought>
<action>verify_route</action>
<action_input>{"route":"{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":80382,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"C=Cc1ccccc1C=C\"},{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)Cl\"}]}]}"} </action_input>

But there is a space before closing tag. Remove.

<action_input>{"route":"{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":80382,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"C=Cc1ccccc1C=C\"},{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)Cl\"}]}]}"}"</action_input>

Note extra quote at end. Should be correct: the outer JSON value is a string, so after the escaped JSON we close the outer string with ". No extra quote.

Thus:

{"route":"{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":80382,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"C=Cc1ccccc1C=C\"},{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)Cl\"}]}]}"}

Let's send.
